title: CRO Example TFL specifications (v2)
description: Defines structure and meta-data for multiple TFLs, keyed by specification ID

datetime.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp when the report was saved

^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*_[a-f0-9]{16}.title: TFL Specification
^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*_[a-f0-9]{16}.description: A single TFL specification containing structure and meta-data

docTemplate.description: Name of the predefined document template

page.title: Page Settings
page.description: Document page configuration including size, orientation, and margins

size.title: Page Size
size.description: Standard paper size for the document

margins.title: Page Margins
margins.description: Margin measurements for all sides of the page

top.title: Top Margin
top.description: Distance from top edge of page to main content area (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

bottom.title: Bottom Margin
bottom.description: Distance from bottom edge of page to main content area (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

left.title: Left Margin
left.description: Distance from left edge of page to main content area (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

right.title: Right Margin
right.description: Distance from right edge of page to main content area (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

header.title: Header Margin
header.description: Distance from top edge of page to header content (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

footer.title: Footer Margin
footer.description: Distance from bottom edge of page to footer content (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

styles.description: Style overrides definitions keyed by style ID

before.description: Space before paragraph (Word typically uses points)

after.description: Space after paragraph (Word typically uses points)

left.description: Left indent (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

right.description: Right indent (Word typically uses inches or centimeters)

first_line.description: First line indent (negative for hanging indent). Word typically uses inches or centimeters

word_style.description: Base Word style to inherit from

font_size.description: Font size in points (Word standard unit)

row_height.title: Row Height
row_height.description: Height of the table row (Word typically uses points)

topEmptyLine.description: Optional blank row height inserted after header and before first body row.

bottomEmptyLine.description: Optional blank row height inserted after last body row and before table bottom border.

docFormat.description: Format of the output file (e.g. docx)

glueNumType.description: Yes to glue the Type and Number to first title (e.g. Listing 16.1 <title 1>), No to keep Type and Number as a separate first row

docOrder.description: Defines the order of the output (e.g. when outputs are combined to a single document)

isContinues.title: Is table continues or has page breaks
isContinues.description: Yes if page breaks should be ignored

continuousSection.title: Continuous section break
continuousSection.description: When true, the page break before this spec is suppressed and it continues on the same page as the previous spec

contentWidth.title: Width of the doc Content
contentWidth.description: Defines the width of the content, e.g. the desired width of the Table or Image (Word typically uses percentage, inches, or centimeters)

footnotePlace.title: Footnote placement
footnotePlace.description: Where to place footnotes: 'doc_footer' = inside the Word footer (below footer rows), 'repeated' = under the table on every page, 'last_page' = under the table on the last page only

hasData.title: Is document has any data to report
hasData.description: When it set to false we assume that table/listing has no data rows (empty), in that case we can provide the placeholder text to print instead of writing empty table with no rows

topEmptyLine.title: Top empty line
topEmptyLine.description: Optional blank row height inserted after table header and before first body row.

bottomEmptyLine.title: Bottom empty line
bottomEmptyLine.description: Optional blank row height inserted after last body row and before table bottom border.

dataRef.description: List of file names with data in json format or list of picture files

aspectRatio.description: Width/height ratio used when one dimension is missing or when fitting

stubColumns.title: Stub columns definition
stubColumns.description: Provides description of stub (spanning) headers in format 'stub_id':{<params>}

labelStyleRef.description: Style IDs to be applied to stub label

columns.title: Data Columns Description
columns.description: Provides description of each data column in format 'col_id':{<params>}

colOrder.description: Position of column in the data

isID.description: Defines if the column should be repeated as Identifier if table spans more than one page

isVisible.description: Defines whether the column should be reported or not

isGrouping.description: Is column defines group of values

isPaging.description: Specify if column defines the page breaks

labelStyleRef.description: IDs of the defined styles to be applied to the column label

isColBreak.description: If Yes the output will be split to next page on this column

dedupe.description: Defines if duplicated values should be removed

format.description: defines the column data type and representation format
defines the format for numeric data type in terms of Sprintf()

missings.description: Defines how to report missing values in numeric columns

colWidth.description: Column width (Word typically uses percentage, inches, or centimeters)

styleRows.title: Rows Styling Data
styleRows.description: Represents a column with the length equal to number of rows in data and contains a strings that describes the styling and other actions to be performed on a given data row when reporting

items.title: styling rules
items.description: Each element is a text string where the rules applied to the given row of table is described

titles.title: Output Titles
titles.description: Provides a set of output titles with different styling (if required)

items.title: Titles
items.description: Array of strings that represents the titles. When reported they should be concatenated using soft line break to represent one paragraph of text

styleRef.description: Style IDs that define the styling of the text group

toclevel.description: Optional TOC level (1-9). When set, the first occurrence of this title is marked as a Table of Contents entry so the user can add a TOC in Word. Multi-line titles are concatenated with space; inline styling is stripped for the TOC entry.

subtitles.title: Output Subtitles
subtitles.description: Provides a set of output subtitles with different styling (if required)

items.title: Titles
items.description: Array of strings that represents the titles. When reported they should be concatenated using soft line break to represent one paragraph of text

styleRef.description: Style IDs that define the styling of the text group

footnotes.title: Output Footnotes
footnotes.description: Provides a set of output footnotes with different styling (if required)

items.title: Titles
items.description: Array of strings that represents the titles. When reported they should be concatenated using soft line break to represent one paragraph of text

styleRef.description: Style IDs that define the styling of the text group

bodyText.title: Body Text
bodyText.description: This is a text that will be printed instead of the table or figure when e.g. there is no data to report (i.e. hasData is false)

items.title: Titles
items.description: Set of strings to be reported in one paragraph

styleRef.description: Style IDs that define the styling of the text group

width.description: Border width in points (Word standard unit)
